title: Physiotherapy Reported Errors and safety eVEnts in iNTensive care
summary:
Treatment in an intensive care unit is often complex and demanding. During physiotherapy, situations may also occur that can be undesirable or potentially harmful to patients.
With this anonymous survey, we would like to find out which situations physiotherapists experience, what consequences they have, and how they are managed.
The results are intended to help make physiotherapy in intensive care units safer for both patients and physiotherapists.

interventions.name:
Physiotherapists in critical care in german speaking countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland)
One-time online survey of physical therapists conducted over a 4-week period

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Physiotherapists who have worked in an intensive care setting within the past month.
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete completion of the questions.
